## Activity

During December 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 94 captures. Overall activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that scheduled imaging work proceeded without a reported disruption to the service.

## Image quality

Image quality should continue to be monitored as part of routine operational review. There were 8 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 8.5 per cent. These cases could not be assessed for grading and should be considered when reviewing image acquisition, patient preparation and session processes. The result provides a useful baseline for ongoing quality improvement at Hill Counties Health Centre.

## Grading

A total of 14 results were graded referable during December 2025. The median grading lag was 2. This indicates that grading activity continued alongside capture and image-quality processes, while maintaining visibility of cases requiring referral. The figures should be reviewed together to support service planning and to identify any opportunities to reduce ungradable images and sustain timely grading.
